title: Heptabase Updates - Whiteboard Location Panel, Multi-select Mindmap Nodes, November AMA
summary: Heptabase Updates - Whiteboard Location Panel, Multi-select Mindmap Nodes, November AMA
body_markdown:
Dear Heptabase User,


Last weekend, our CEO Alan hosted his second AMA event in our Discord community. He answered questions about Heptabase's product direction for Q1 2025, our plans for AI integration, spaced repetition, and quick capture features. You can find the complete AMA record on our[public wiki](https://wiki.heptabase.com/ama-2024-11) !


---


### Right sidebar: Whiteboard Location Panel​


In the latest version, you can see all the whiteboards that a card appears on in the right sidebar. Just open a card in a new full tab, you will find the whiteboard location panel.


We’ll soon release an upgrade that will let you open and edit the whiteboard directly in the panel. Stay tuned!


---


### Mindmap: Multi-select nodes​


You can now drag a selection box or hold down the Shift key to select multiple nodes in your mindmap. This lets you turn several nodes into cards, tag and fold multiple card nodes, or delete them all at once.


---


We hope that these updates will improve your experience on Heptabase and make your learning easier and more enjoyable.


If you have any feedback or suggestions, or you want to share your use cases or contents related to Heptabase, please don't hesitate to chat with us through our[in app support](https://support.heptabase.com/en/articles/10448156-how-can-i-contact-heptabase-support) .


Stay tuned for future updates, and we hope you have a great day!


Best regards,


Heptabase Team
